title: Imba yeGirazi Rine Magirazi
intro: Fungidzira nyika iri kure ine pfuma nerunako uko zuva rinonamatwa panzvimbo peMusiki waro. Tsamba inosvika ine chikumbiro chisingafaniri kufuratirwa, uye rwendo rwunotanga kuenda kudare guru kupfuura chero ripi zvaro rakamboonekwa. Ikoko, fungidziro ichafumurwa nepasi rinonyengera maziso, uye nguva yekujeka ichachinja zvese.
clues: Ndakatonga nyika yakabudirira ine vanhu vaipfugamira zuva pachinzvimbo chaAllah.
Ndakagamuchira tsamba yakanaka ichinditi ndisazvikwidziridze asi kuti ndizviise pasi paAllah.
Ndakabvunza kanzuru yangu ndikasarudza diplomacy kutanga, ndichitumira chipo kuti ndiedze munhu akatuma.
Ndakasvika kuna Sulayman, uye chigaro changu cheumambo chakaiswa kwandiri chakavanzwa kuti chionekwe kuti ndiri munhu ani.
Ndakapinda muimba yamambo yakakwirira ine pasi rakatsetseka regirazi randaifunga kuti mvura yakadzika.
Ndakazivisa kuzviisa kwangu kuna Sulayman kuna Allah, Ishe wepasi rose.

trial.label: Kutongwa/Chiitiko
options: Ndarohwa nemakore akawanda ekurwara uye kurasikirwa nemhuri
Yakaedzwa nechigaro cheumambo chakavanzwa uye imba yegirazi
Akakandwa mumoto unopfuta nekuda kwekuputsa zvifananidzo
trial.answer: Yakaedzwa nechigaro cheumambo chakavanzwa uye imba yegirazi

outcome.label: Mhedzisiro
options: Ndakaramba ndisingatende uye ndakaparadzwa pamwe chete nevanhu vangu
Akazviisa pasi paSulayman kuna Allah, Ishe wepasi rose
Akachinjwa kuva dombo nekuda kwekutyora Sabata
outcome.answer: Akazviisa pasi paSulayman kuna Allah, Ishe wepasi rose

arabic: فَلَمَّا جَآءَتْ قِيلَ أَهَـٰكَذَا عَرْشُكِ ۖ قَالَتْ كَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ ۚ وَأُوتِينَا ٱلْعِلْمَ مِن قَبْلِهَا وَكُنَّا مُسْلِمِينَ
verse: So when she arrived, it was said [to her], "Is your throne like this?" She said, "[It is] as though it was it." [Solomon said], "And we were given knowledge before her, and we have been Muslims [in submission to Allāh]. (27:42)
